scope_changes_requiring_complete_accepta: Explicit new ETH_SOL development batch; old closed attempts and gates unchanged
No profitable-baseline prerequisite; new performance-alert semantics apply to new proposed delivery policy only
Development economic decision before independent confirmation; confirmation feasibility planned conditionally from development, not presumed known before training
mechanism: Finite-horizon reversion of ETH/SOL standardized log-price residual can cover complete sequential two-leg execution costs

selection.objective: max min(Q1 base liquidation equity, Q1 stress liquidation equity) minus initial equity
selection.q1_boundary: Checkpoint every state, including positions, cash, pending orders, risk peak, causal feature window and alerts; resume only winner and baseline, never reset

model.regression: Daily causal OLS log ETH on intercept and log SOL, preceding 1440 closed hours

execution.base_prices: Scheduled minute open plus adverse slippage and tick
execution.stress_prices: Scheduled minute high on buy or low on sell plus adverse slippage and tick
execution.attribution: Gross uses identical executed quantities and times at unadjusted minute open; slippage is every actual reference-fill difference from that open including high/low and tick; fees and signed funding separate, no double deduction
execution.funding: Original timestamp, signed quantity times mark open times rate, before fills at equal timestamp; not cost-multiplied

risk_and_alert.alert_action: Freeze updates; new reference path retains fixed trading policy under all hard risks; deterministic data/accounting/execution review immediately
risk_and_alert.review_failure_action: No new exposure, unwind under original constraints, retain residual liability and stop as insufficient

confirmation_planning_only.independent_input: Only new prospective data after full policy freeze; no history relabeling
confirmation_planning_only.test_family: All base/stress absolute means positive, and if learned all base/stress paired gains positive
confirmation_planning_only.choose: Smallest option covering all tests and variance sensitivities; invalid variance/event concentration yields no horizon
confirmation_planning_only.assumptions: Weak stationarity, finite second moments, chosen lags approximate dependence, Gaussian planning approximation; unobserved tails/regime changes not bounded
confirmation_planning_only.future_start_rule: Only after separate complete candidate engineering/confirmation scope is accepted and execution/statistical calibration passes, first full UTC Monday; one fixed terminal endpoint, no success peeking or extension
